name: Neko Para Extra: Koneko no Hi no Yakusoku
original_name: ネコぱらExtra  仔ネコの日の約束
source:
After being taken in by Kashou and his little sister, Shigure, the young kittens, Chocola and Vanilla find it difficult to fit in. Despite the warm welcome the other Minaduki catgirls give to them, they act with trepidation as they adjust to the pace of the family.

As they slowly interact with their fellow sister catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla begin to open up more and it's here we see Kashou's kindness towards them that builds up their feelings towards him.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2018-07-07/sekai-project-adds-nekopara-extra-6-other-games/.133977]Anime News Network[/url]]

Nekopara Extra is an extra episode in the series that was part of a stretch goal from the Nekopara OVA crowdfunding campaign. The lovable catgirls, Chocola and Vanilla, are back and this time the story focuses on their first arrival at the Minazuki household before the events of Nekopara Vol. 1.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899970/NEKOPARA_Extra/]Steam page[/url]]
translation:
被嘉祥和妹妹時雨收留後，小貓娘巧克力與香草很難融入新家。儘管水無月家的其他貓娘熱情歡迎她們，剛開始和大家一起生活時，兩隻小貓娘仍有些怕生。

隨著她們逐漸和其他貓娘姊妹相處，巧克力和香草開始敞開心扉；也正是在這段過程中，她們感受到了嘉祥對自己的溫柔，並逐漸對他產生感情。

[來源：[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2018-07-07/sekai-project-adds-nekopara-extra-6-other-games/.133977]Anime News Network[/url]]

《NEKOPARA Extra：小貓之日的約定》是系列的特別篇，源自《貓娘樂園》OVA群眾募資活動的追加目標。可愛的貓娘巧克力和香草回來了，這一次，故事聚焦於她們來到水無月家、發生在《貓娘樂園Vol.1》之前的經歷。

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/899970/NEKOPARA_Extra/]Steam頁面[/url]]
